extra:
## This work (Р-251, English works series, one at a time)

Source: the English original `gothic-by-gaslight-en` (text layer; `python -B pipeline/source/pages.py show gothic-by-gaslight-en <page>`; page image `python -B pipeline/source/pages.py image gothic-by-gaslight-en <physical page> --physical`). Page numbers: `pagemap` often misses printed numbers in these PDFs — look at 2–3 page images and find printed vs physical; in `sources` give the printed page as printed (null for unnumbered pages). Offset is set (printed = physical on 4–81). Do NOT edit `pipeline/source/books.json` — report any other offset (physical = printed − offset, e.g. «p. 3» on physical 4 → offset −1) and the lead sets it.
Russian text — our translation (flag `translated`); official Russian forms of names and terms — glossary `python -B tools/terms.py <word>` and existing records (Р-184), e.g. Dreamlands = «Страна грёз»; Hard/Extreme roll = «трудная/чрезвычайная проверка» (official «трудный/чрезвычайный успех», never «сложная»). New terms of this book — choose one Russian form each, use it everywhere, and list them all in your report (English → Russian); the translator of the book will reuse exactly these forms.
- FIRST: check that this scenario is not already in the base under a Russian translation (Grep key character and place names, transliterated, in `kb/books/*-ru/`; e.g. «The Haunted Clubhouse» was already there as «Маленький клуб ужасов»). If it is — do NOT create a second set: per Р-147 the translation keeps the text, the original gives the numbers; write proposals to the translation records (English sources, `name.en`, errata for translation errors) and report.
- Victorian Britain 1886–1897, mostly London: era gaslight. A short campaign of four scenarios plus a frame chapter, split into 3 units — see «Shared scheme» below.
- One `scenario` record (summary, keeper_info, hook, advice, steps with refs, conclusion with Sanity rewards, tables), every scene (`arc`), characters (stat blocks as printed, Р-25; pregenerated investigators are characters with role `pregen`; unnamed crowds — group profile with invented `names`, Р-151), creatures (known Mythos creatures and deities → `instance_of` the shared record, Grep `kb/creatures` first; a unique being — book record), organizations, items and clues, tomes and spells (known spells → refs to the shared `coc:spell:*`), handouts (text as printed + our full translation), places (a real city — the shared record `coc:location:<city>` if it exists (Grep first), book places `part_of` it; a fictional town — a book place with its places `part_of` it; do not create shared records in `kb/locations/`), maps (`map` records with a spot on every printed label, Р-206; every key number without a record gets a small place record).
- Helper scripts — only in your own scratchpad subfolder `gen-gothic` (other helpers run in parallel and use the same scratchpad).
- Book-scoped ids `gothic-by-gaslight-en/<kind>/<slug>` in `kb/books/gothic-by-gaslight-en/<kinds>/`.
- Pictures (skill `.claude/skills/kb-art/SKILL.md`, Р-241, Р-245): portraits, creature art, handouts, item pictures, maps — mapping `checks/20261116-gothic/art.json`, `python -B pipeline/art/add_images.py … --dry-run` then real; apply the proposals yourself (`pipeline/integrate/apply.py`) — you own this book; atmosphere pictures (cover, decoration, mood art not tied to a record) → `checks/20261116-gothic/atmosphere.json` (the lead merges it). File prefix for pictures: `gothic-`.
- Lessons from earlier checks (skill kb-import, «Ошибки, которые уже находили»): every page of an entry in `sources`; handout texts in full; maps are `map` records, not atmosphere; no two records with the same `name.ru`; terms inside text agree with the record names; book misprints kept as printed, in `errata`, with the obvious ones fixed in `corrections`.
- When done, run `python -I -B tools/completeness.py --books gothic-by-gaslight-en --out checks/20261116-gothic/completeness` and `python -I -B tools/scenario_check.py --books gothic-by-gaslight-en --out checks/20261116-gothic/scenario` and fix what they find; then `python -B tools/check.py kb/books/gothic-by-gaslight-en` — 0 errors.
- Coverage: in `checks/20261116-gothic/gothic.md` list every heading of the book → the record that holds it (or «не взято» with the reason), misprints, and the term list (English → Russian).

## Shared scheme of this book (3 units work in parallel — keep to it exactly)

A short campaign (Miskatonic Repository, 2026): a frame chapter and four scenarios, each also playable as a one-shot. Model of a campaign: one `scenario` record for the whole campaign (`gothic-by-gaslight-en/scenario/gothic-by-gaslight`), each chapter a `scenario` record with `part_of` → it (as `kb/books/griby-s-yuggota-ru/scenarios/*.json` with `part_of` `…/fungi-from-yuggoth`). Victorian London: era `gaslight`; places `part_of` the shared `coc:location:london` (exists; do not edit it).
Each unit writes ONLY its own files. Refer to records of other units by the ids below even before they exist — dangling refs to these ids are expected until all units finish (list them in your report); no stubs.
- Unit frame: `gothic-by-gaslight-en/scenario/gothic-by-gaslight` (campaign: summary, keeper_info, hook, steps → the four chapter records, campaign conclusion), organization `gothic-by-gaslight-en/organization/the-dreadfuls` (the Book Club «The Dreadfuls»), place `gothic-by-gaslight-en/location/book-club` (Paternoster Row club house; the Book Club Library & Reading Room of ch. 3 is described by unit childe as `gothic-by-gaslight-en/location/book-club-library` part_of it), character `gothic-by-gaslight-en/character/ms-lannigan` (if she appears), investigator creation and other rules of ch. 1 as `rule` records; plus the whole of chapter 2 «Hyde and Seek» (`gothic-by-gaslight-en/scenario/hyde-and-seek`).
- Unit childe: chapter 3 «The Childe of Frankenstein» (`gothic-by-gaslight-en/scenario/the-childe-of-frankenstein`), its handouts and maps (p. 40–50).
- Unit countess: chapters 4 «Lady Nemo» (`gothic-by-gaslight-en/scenario/lady-nemo`) and 5 «The Countess» (`gothic-by-gaslight-en/scenario/the-countess`), and the recurring villain `gothic-by-gaslight-en/character/the-countess` (Elizabeth Báthory; her full profile/stat block from ch. 5; earlier chapters refer to this id).
- Other ids: slug of the English name (`gothic-by-gaslight-en/character/edward-hyde`, `gothic-by-gaslight-en/location/<slug>`, `gothic-by-gaslight-en/scene/<chapter-short>-<slug>` e.g. `hyde-act-1-murders-most-foul`, `childe-…`, `nemo-…`, `countess-…`). A character met in several chapters is owned by the unit of the chapter where the book gives the stat block; others refer to it.
- Coverage file `checks/20261116-gothic/gothic-<unit>.md` per unit; art mapping `art-<unit>.json`, atmosphere `atmosphere-<unit>.json`, proposals `proposals-<unit>.json`; picture prefix `gothic-<unit>-`.
- completeness/scenario_check: run by every unit at the end on the whole book (other units' gaps are expected — report only yours); `python -B tools/check.py kb/books/gothic-by-gaslight-en` — only dangling refs to scheme ids of other units are acceptable.
